messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- Ledger depends on the authentication gateway for service tokens. [valid 2025-03-14 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-14]
- Billing-api depends on the flags service as of 2025-10-21. [valid 2025-10-21 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-10-21]
- The reporting service still relies on the event bus as of 2025-11-13. [valid 2025-11-13 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-13]
- The reporting service must stay on Python 3.11 until the pandas 3 upgrade lands. [constraint; valid 2025-05-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-05-15]
- The reporting service has a deploy window on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-03-05 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-05]
- The reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy, as noticed by Cinder on 2025-08-20. [valid 2025-08-20 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-20]
- Diego held the Cinder on-call phone from 2025-11-25 until 2025-12-15, after which Yuki took it over. [decision; valid 2025-12-15 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-12-15]
    earlier: Diego took over the Cinder on-call phone as of 2025-11-25, with Yuki off rotation. [decision; valid 2025-11-25 to 2025-12-15; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-11-25]
    earlier: Yuki took over the Cinder on-call phone as of 2025-10-02, with Diego off rotation. [decision; valid 2025-10-02 to 2025-11-25; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-10-02]
    earlier: Diego took over the Cinder on-call phone as of 2025-08-29. [decision; valid 2025-08-29 to 2025-10-02; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-29]
    earlier: Yuki took over the Cinder on-call phone as of 2025-07-22. [decision; valid 2025-07-22 to 2025-08-29; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-22]
- Billing-api depends on Ledger to work. [constraint; valid 2026-03-05 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-05]
- As of 2025-09-19, the reporting service reads from the event bus instead of querying Ledger directly. [decision; valid 2025-09-19 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-19]
- The job scheduler depends on the flags service for per-job kill switches; if the flags service is down, the job scheduler is down. [valid 2025-03-28 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-28]
- The reporting service was moved off direct Ledger queries because nightly Ledger scans were blocking billing runs. [valid 2025-09-19 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-19]
- The product catalog depends on image-resizer for thumbnails. [valid 2025-03-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-03-28]
- The indexer depends on the product catalog for product documents. [valid 2025-03-03 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-03-03]
- The reports pipeline depends on Ledger for the nightly balance export, so if Ledger is down the reports pipeline is down. [valid 2025-02-06 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-02-06]
- Ember handed the webhooks service to Team Atlas on 2025-09-09. [valid 2025-09-09 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-09-webhooks]
- Yuki walked Farah through the flags service runbook on 2026-01-29. [valid 2026-01-29 to now; recorded by handover/2026-01-29-feature-flags]
- The flags service moved from Cinder to Team Dune on 2026-01-29. [decision; valid 2026-01-29 to now; recorded by handover/2026-01-29-feature-flags]
- The webhooks service will require an idempotency key on every delivery. [decision; valid 2026-02-11 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- The flags service moved from Team Dune to Team Atlas on 2026-04-21. [decision; valid 2026-04-21 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-21-feature-flags]
- The webhooks service has a deploy window on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21]
